claims.summary: Single evaluation functional: over every field, for the functional pigeonhole system's reduced-board quotients A_k (modulo the domain, V_k; modulo the closure, V_k/W_k with W_k the span of the x_s Q_i' with |s|+1 <= k) and L >= K >= 0: if evaluation at a set X of partial matchings at which every element of W_{K+L} vanishes is injective on A_K, the sum lambda of the evaluations at dim A_K of those points with bijective evaluation leaves no nonzero u in A_K with lambda(u v) = 0 for all v in A_L (lambda(uv) = (Mu)^T(Mv), M invertible). Instances: modulo the domain with X the partial matchings of size <= K, on every board; modulo the closure with X the total matchings, where they embed A_K, computed over F_2 at K = 2 on the reduced boards with 3 and 4 pigeons and 8 holes. So a variable error with 1+K+L <= D <= ceil(N/2) and L >= K has native count 1 in those cases, by lem:native-restriction.
claims.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with corrections, checked in one follow-up; its general form and instance (ii) follow the reviewer's suggestion, instance (ii) computed over F_2 only.
claims.rationale: Settles the ratio-one cases of the native count explicitly wherever point evaluations embed the quotient, the matching down-set's version of the cube's single-functional construction.
claims.next_action: The closure's case at K = L with more pigeons than holes, where no point kills W, first by a symmetric pseudo-expectation over Q.

claims.summary: Conjecture: over every field, on every reduced board of the functional pigeonhole system with p pigeons and n holes and at every K, L >= 0 with 1+K+L <= ceil((n+1)/2), the least number of functionals lambda_j on A_{K+L} leaving no nonzero u in A_K with lambda_j(u v) = 0 for all v in A_L equals ceil(dim A_K / dim A_L), both modulo the domain (A_k = V_k(B)) and modulo the closure (A_k = V_k(B)/W_k(B)); so by lem:native-restriction a variable error's native count with 1+K+L <= D <= ceil(N/2) is that ratio on its reduced board. Evidence: check:reduced-native-counts (K = 2, L = 1, six and seven holes), check:native-ratio-counts (K = 3, L = 1 and K = L = 2, eight holes), check:one-native-functional (K = L = 1), all over F_2, the boards at (3,1) and (2,2) having fewer pigeons than holes; proved modulo the domain for L >= K, and modulo the closure where total matchings embed A_K (computed over F_2 at two boards), by lem:single-evaluation-functional.
claims.assessment: Conjecture from finite checks over F_2; the boards at (3,1) and (2,2) have fewer pigeons than holes, so the pigeonhole regime is tested only at (2,1) and (1,1); scope and evidence checked by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer.
claims.rationale: States the native cost on the functional pigeonhole system in closed form, if true, and would rule out a growth past the ratio there.
claims.next_action: The closure's case at K = L; a construction in the domain model at K > L.

claims.summary: Exact F_2 computation (native_kl.py with tools/f2_span.py) on reduced boards with 8 holes: at K = 3, L = 1, random functionals attain the ratio in both models, with 3 pigeons 22 modulo the domain (529/25) and 16 modulo the closure (336/22) on all 20 seeds, with 4 pigeons 52 (1713/33) on 19 of 20 seeds and 36 (1039/29) on all 20; at K = L = 2 (ratio 1) one functional detects in both models, with 3 pigeons (dim A_2 = 193 and 145) on 15 and 2 of 200 seeds, with 4 pigeons (369 and 275) on 7 and 1 of 20; evaluation at the total matchings embeds A_2 modulo the closure on both boards (ranks 145 and 275, total_eval.py); the script reproduces check:reduced-native-counts at K = 2, L = 1 on six holes for 3 and 4 pigeons. By lem:native-restriction these are the counts of a variable error on the boards with 4 and 5 pigeons and 9 holes at D = 5.
claims.assessment: Exact computation checked by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer (script generalization, product table, annihilator, every figure, total_eval.py); upper bounds from random functionals over F_2 only.
claims.rationale: Evidence for conj:native-ratio-attained at two more slacks.
claims.next_action: Five or more pigeons at eight holes; other fields.
